title: Umuhamagaro Wakomeje Guhinduka mu Bihe Bishize
intro: Tekereza umuntu wahagaze wenyine arwanya umuco wose, yiyemeje kubayobora kuva mu buyobe afite icyemezo kidakuka. Mu binyejana byinshi, ubutumwa bwaranzwe, bugashinyagurirwa, kandi bugasuzugurwa—nyamara imbaraga ntizahagaze. Amaherezo, haje kubazwa byinshi, maze bake gusa ni bo bakira agakiza hamwe n’uwo muntu uhamye. Ese ushobora kumenya uyu muntu muri Korowani?
clues: Natumwe kuba umuburira ku bantu bazimiye mu nzira zabo bwite.
Nabatumiye gusaba imbabazi no kwihana bakareka amakosa yabo, ariko barayanze.
Myobowe n'Imana, nakoze ubwato bunini cyane abantu banjye bandebaga bakananseka.
Nahamagaye Umwami wanjye ubudasiba—amaherezo aranyitaba, maze amazi asuka mu ijuru nk'umugezi mwinshi.
Nagiye mu bwato hamwe n'abizera igihe amazi y'umwuzure yazamukaga hejuru y'ubutaka.
Naratabaje umwe wari wasigaye inyuma, mbasaba guhungira ku musozi, ariko itegeko ryari ryaramaze gutorwa.
